description: RSS/Atom/JSON feed as compact items. Saves 27-81%; on lean feeds skip unless you cannot parse XML.

max_sats.description: Most this call may charge. Minimum 1. A higher total charges nothing.

url.description: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed URL, or an HTML page that links a feed.

name: read_feed

outputSchema.description: Content plus the charge. content is empty when the call did not deliver. truncated is true when content is shorter than the source.

approval_url.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

balance_sats.description: Credit balance after the call, or null when it was not read.

code.description: approval_required, limit_exceeded, or insufficient_balance when the call stopped.

content.description: Delivered text. Empty when the call did not deliver.

order_id.description: Order id after a charge. Null when nothing was charged.

sats_charged.description: Sats charged for this call. 0 when nothing was charged.

total_length.description: Characters before truncation. Larger than content_length when truncated is true.

truncated.description: True when the source was longer than content, or the page itself was cut.

which.description: Which limit: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Read feed
